```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
```

## Load data

```{r}
daily_trips <- read_tsv('trips_per_day_2015.tsv')

og_weather <- read_csv('weather_2015.csv') %>%
    mutate(TMAX=TMAX/10, TMIN=TMIN/10) %>%
    rename(ymd= DATE, prcp=PRCP, snwd=SNWD, snow=SNOW, tmax=TMAX, tmin=TMIN) %>%
    select(-STATION, -NAME, -TAVG)

# Join the two datasets above
final_data <- inner_join(daily_trips, og_weather, by = "ymd")

final_data <- final_data %>% 
    mutate(day = wday(ymd),date= as.numeric(format(ymd, "%Y%m%d"))) 

load(here("week3", "model.Rdata"))
summary(model3)
```

## Compute the RMSE between the actual and predicted trips for 2015
```{r}
rmse(model3, final_data) # 40758.8
rsquare(model3, final_data) # 68.53%
```
